name: Hotel Maria Cristina
insider_take: Belle Époque glamour meets Basque culinary paradise on the banks of the Urumea River
whats_special: This iconic 1912 palace has hosted royalty, film stars, and dignitaries for over a century. Located directly across from La Concha Beach—consistently ranked among Europe's most beautiful urban beaches—the hotel sits in the heart of San Sebastián's gastronomic capital, which boasts more Michelin stars per capita than anywhere else in the world.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room during the San Sebastián International Film Festival in September—you'll have front-row seats to the red carpet arrivals at the nearby Kursaal Congress Centre.
dont_miss: The legendary Dry Martini Bar, unchanged since the 1940s, and a pintxos crawl through Parte Vieja (Old Town)—just a 5-minute stroll away. The hotel's position makes it the perfect base for exploring both the beach promenade and the UNESCO World Heritage culinary scene.
pros: Historic Belle Époque palace with timeless elegance
Prime location overlooking Urumea River and Kursaal Congress Centre
Walking distance to La Concha Beach and Old Town pintxos bars
Luxury Collection standards with exceptional service and amenities
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes
